about:
# ForeverForge Broker

Open ForeverForge settings and layout controls from a broker bar.

For **World of Warcraft: Forever** (interface 16001).

- Convenient ForeverForge and ForgeUI controls.
- Access to available frame-moving and configuration tools.
- Standalone companion with no copied upstream UI suite.

## Requirements

ForeverForge

Optional integrations: ForeverForge_UI.

A LibDataBroker display such as Bazooka is needed to show broker controls.

## Controls

Use the ForeverForge broker object.

## Installation

Install through CurseForge or extract the ZIP into your Forever Interface/AddOns folder. Keep the packaged folder name `ForeverForge_LDB` unchanged; this also preserves existing saved settings. Enable the listed dependencies.

## Publishing

Push a stable annotated version tag matching the TOC, such as `v1.0.1`, to publish. GitHub Actions validates the source and packages a GitHub release; the connected CurseForge native packager handles the CurseForge Release file through its push webhook. No CurseForge publishing token belongs in this repository or its Actions secrets.

## Feedback

[Report an issue](https://github.com/bhuddleston42/ForeverForgeBroker/issues) with the addon version, expected behavior and Lua error if available.

## Testing

Release packaging and Lua syntax are checked automatically. Included regression tests use simulated game APIs. Real gameplay and combinations of third-party addons can expose additional issues; please report them.
